questions: Where is your hometown located, and what is it like living there?
What do you like most about your hometown?
Has your hometown changed much since you were a child?
Would you prefer to live in your hometown in the future or move elsewhere?
Do you work or are you currently a student?
What made you choose this subject or career path?
What is the most interesting aspect of your work or study?
What do you plan to do in the next few years regarding your career?
What is your typical morning routine?
Do you prefer having a strict daily schedule or being spontaneous?
Which part of the day do you find yourself most productive?
Do you usually have enough free time during the week?
How often do you use social media applications in your daily life?
Do you think smartphones make people more or less connected?
What kind of technological device could you not live without?
Have your technology habits changed over the past few years?
What do you usually enjoy doing during your weekends?
Do you prefer spending your free time alone or with other people?
Did you have the same hobbies when you were younger?
Is there a new hobby or skill you would like to take up soon?

part2.title: Describe a memorable journey you have taken
bullets: Where you went and how you travelled there
Who you went with
What you did and experienced during the trip
And explain why this journey was especially memorable to you
part3: Why do some people prefer travelling alone while others prefer travelling in groups?
How has modern transportation influenced international tourism?
What are the economic and environmental impacts of tourism on local communities?
Do you think virtual travel experiences could ever replace real travel in the future?

part2.title: Describe an important decision you made in your life
bullets: What the decision was and when you made it
What factors you had to consider
Whether you asked anyone for advice
And explain why this decision was significant to your life
part3: Why do young people sometimes find it difficult to make career decisions?
Do you think people should rely on logic or intuition when making major life choices?
How has the internet changed the way people make consumer decisions?
Should parents make important decisions for their teenage children?

part2.title: Describe a useful skill you learned recently
bullets: What the skill is and why you wanted to learn it
How and where you learned it
How long it took you to learn
And explain how this skill has helped you in your daily life
part3: What practical skills should schools teach that are currently neglected?
Is it easier for children to learn new skills compared to adults? Why?
How has artificial intelligence changed the skills required in the modern workplace?
Do you think teamwork is a skill that can be taught effectively?

part2.title: Describe a person who has inspired you
bullets: Who this person is and how you know them
What they have achieved or what qualities they possess
What you learned from their example
And explain why you find them particularly inspiring
part3: What qualities make someone a good role model for teenagers?
Do you think public figures and celebrities have a moral responsibility to set a good example?
How do cultural differences affect people's definitions of success?
Are leaders born with leadership qualities, or can leadership be developed?

part2.title: Describe an environmental problem in your country
bullets: What the problem is and where it occurs
What the main causes of this problem are
How it affects people and wildlife
And explain what steps should be taken to address it
part3: Whose responsibility is it to combat climate change: individual citizens or governments?
How can educational institutions encourage sustainable habits among students?
Do you think economic growth and environmental protection can coexist?
What role does international cooperation play in solving global ecological challenges?
